homilies.title: 將臨期第一主日道理：醒寤迎接基督
homilies.content:
今天是將臨期第一主日，教會開始新的禮儀年。將臨期提醒我們必須時刻懷有信、望、愛三德，以期待基督第二次的來臨，那時，我們將分享他永恆的恩賜。

在基督來臨前，教會將要經歷一個動搖許多信徒信仰的最後考驗。那陪伴她在世旅程的迫害，將揭露在冒牌宗教的方式下的「邪惡的奧秘」，它給人提供一種表面解決問題的方法，但要付出背棄真理的代價。最大的冒牌宗教就是假基督，即是一種冒充的默西亞主義：人追求自己的榮耀而取代天主及在肉身內降世的默西亞。

而在降臨之後:那時各人的行為和心中的秘密將會顯露出來。那時因輕視天主恩寵而犯的不信之罪將受懲罰。對近人的態度將披露出對天主恩寵與慈愛的接納或拒絕。耶穌將在最後一天說：「凡你們對我這些最小兄弟中的一個所做的，就是對我做的」(瑪 25:40)。

那基督是以怎樣方式將臨呢?大部分人都認為主耶穌再來肯定是駕雲降臨，眾目都能看見，正如聖經所載：「加利利人哪，你們為什麼站著望天呢？這離開你們被接升天的耶穌，你們見他怎樣往天上去，他還要怎樣來。」（宗徒大事錄 1:11）「那時，人子的兆頭要顯在天上，地上的萬族都要哀哭。他們要看見人子有能力，有大榮耀，駕著天上的雲降臨。」（瑪竇福音 24:30）因此，大家看天望雲多年，癡癡地等待著主突然在哪一個大喜的日子駕著白雲重歸接我們回去。

可是這麼多年過去了，仍不見主耶穌在末世駕雲降臨。但如果我們仔細查考聖經中有關主再來的預言，就不難發現不光有主駕雲降臨的預言，還有主隱祕降臨的預言，就如默示錄 3:3：「若不儆醒，我必臨到你那裡，如同賊一樣。我幾時臨到，你也絕不能知道。」默示錄 16:15：「看哪，我來像賊一樣。那儆醒、看守衣服，免得赤身而行，叫人見他羞恥的有福了！」還有馬爾谷福音 13:32：「但那日子、那時辰沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。」這些預言中都提到，主要像「賊」一樣來，一說像「賊」，那就是隱祕地，悄無聲息地，而且在任何人都不知道的情況下回來。

由此可見，我們的救主回來是以兩種方式降臨：一種是道成肉身成為人子來，像賊一樣，誰也不知道，隱祕降臨；一種是駕雲降臨，公開向人顯現。

最後，我們的主，不提醒門徒到底哪一天世界末日要到是有道理的，因為他要他們時時都準備好自己的心去迎接救主。耶穌要我們時常儆醒:儆醒是指睜大眼睛，尋找真正的光明，做還有遵守自己所相信的事情，並且擺脫黑暗以免懶惰或疏忽。

賊通常不是在白天出現，而是出現在晚上:也就是在邪惡猖狂的時候；在這種情況下，當一個人有困難的時候，儘管他沒有太陽的熱力保護，但他能被來自聖言光所光照，就像來自一盞燈。

當我們受誘惑或任何災難的時候，盜賊最容易闖進來，試圖毀壞靈魂的房子。主也是要警戒我們，不要只是對於物質上的房子保護得特別好，更要緊的是要保護好我們的靈性房子:靈魂---聖神的宮殿。

願聖母幫助我們在應付靈性生活超過應付物質的生活。

homilies.title: 將臨期第二主日道理：基督的真人性與正義
homilies.content:
今天要講論關於耶穌基督是真人與正義

由葉瑟的樹幹將生出一個嫩枝；由它的樹根將發出一個幼芽。從根上，排除了兩個異端。

其中一個說，基督沒有真正的肉體；另一個說，基督有真實肉體，但它不是從亞當和他的祖先或其他人那裏繁衍出的，而是由上帝在聖母胎中無中創造的；或者說，它來自我們的原組父母，像一種光一樣單獨存在，從未被原罪的傳染所感染。

這個異端被完全排除了，在這裏他說從聖母的父母中升起，就像花從根部升起。猶太人說，花和棍子指的是基督；他被稱為棍子是因為他的力量和對惡人的鞭打，而花則是因為他的誠實和對好人的安慰。傑羅姆說，馬太福音2:23所說的就是來自這節經文：他將被稱為拿撒勒人，也就是花的意思。那些把這一章解釋為關於約西亞和以西結的人也是這樣解釋的，他們說約西亞和以西結被說成是耶西的後裔，而不是他們更近的祖先，因為對大衛作出了在他兒子身上確認王國的承諾。

他不按人的眼光來判斷。這裏他表明了他在行為的正確性方面的聖潔，特別是在判斷方面，因為這是一個國王的工作。因此，他表明了三件事。

第一，他在辨別方面的聰明才智。

第二，他在執行方面的公正性：但他要審判。

第三，他堅忍不拔的精神，而正義必在（賽11:5）。

所以他說，對於第一條，他不按外在的眼睛看，也不按外在的耳朵聽，就好像對那些在馬太福音22:16所說的，主人，我們知道你是一個真正的說話者。因為他不需要任何人為人作見證，因為他知道人裏面的東西（約2:25）。這裡不能把基督看成普通的人，以免人說根據撒母耳記上16:7所說的：人看的是那些外表的東西，而主看的是心。而去誤會我們的救主。因此，他們分別說，現在我們知道你什麼都知道了（約16：30）。儘管如此，還有人以一種折磨人的方式解釋這句話，認為是關於正義的國王，因為他們沒有按照諂媚來判斷乍看的事物，而是勤奮地尋求案件的真相。

但他要判斷。這裏顯示了他執行的公正。

首先，對於善良的人，在分配他們的權利時：他要審判，在審判的日子，甚至是現在：父把所有的審判交給了子（約翰福音5:22）；窮人，馬太福音5:3說到他們：精神貧乏的人有福了，因為天國是他們的。

第二，關於惡人，第一，關於肢體：他要用口中的棍子打地，也就是打地上的人：你們這些被咒詛的，去吧，進入永火（馬太福音25：41）；文士和法利賽人，你們有禍了（馬太福音23：13）；

關於頭：用嘴唇的氣，也就是用語言表達他的憤怒；他要殺了惡人，也就是反基督者。罪人要顯出來，就是滅亡之子，他反對並高舉一切稱為神或被敬拜的（帖後2:3-4）；或魔鬼：現在是世界的審判：現在這世界的王要被趕出去（約12:31）。而這一切都可以從字面上解釋為正義的君王，以及用他們的戒律殺死不敬的人。

最後讓我們以堅持不懈的精神：遵守的天主的正義，使天主給我們束好腰，也就是他戰鬥的利劍，以及信仰，來自上帝的信心，人們將因此而獲勝；因為我們都屬於正義的君王---基督。如果我們已經盡力以愛德去愛仇人了，解果卻是不好的，把他們交給天主吧。我們自管耶穌的教導就好。

en.title: Second Sunday of Advent: Christ’s True Humanity and Justice
en.content:
Today we will speak about Jesus Christ's true humanity and his justice.

A shoot shall come forth from the stump of Jesse, and a young branch shall spring from his roots. This reference to the root rules out two heresies.

One claims that Christ did not have real flesh. The other claims that Christ had real flesh, but that it did not descend from Adam, his ancestors, or other human beings. Instead, it was created by God out of nothing in the Blessed Virgin's womb; or, although it came from our first parents, it existed separately like a kind of light and was never infected by the contagion of original sin.

This heresy is completely ruled out here, where he speaks of arising from the Blessed Virgin's parents, just as a flower springs from a root. Jewish interpreters say that the flower and the rod refer to Christ: he is called a rod because of his strength and his chastisement of the wicked, and a flower because of his integrity and the consolation he brings to the good. Jerome says that Matthew 2:23 draws on this verse: he shall be called a Nazarene, which means a flower. Those who interpret this chapter as referring to Josiah and Ezekiel explain it similarly. They say that Josiah and Ezekiel are described as descendants of Jesse, rather than of their nearer ancestors, because David was promised that the kingdom would be established in his son.

He does not judge according to human appearances. Here he shows his holiness in the uprightness of his actions, especially in judgment, for judgment is the work of a king. He therefore reveals three things.

First, his wisdom in discerning.

Second, his impartiality in carrying out justice: he shall judge.

Third, his perseverance: righteousness shall be his girdle (Isaiah 11:5).

Regarding the first point, he does not judge merely by what outward eyes see or outward ears hear. This recalls the words addressed to him in Matthew 22:16: Teacher, we know that you are truthful. He needed no one to bear witness about human beings, for he knew what was within them (John 2:25). Here Christ must not be regarded as an ordinary human being, lest the words of 1 Samuel 16:7—human beings look at outward appearances, but the Lord looks at the heart—lead anyone to misunderstand our Saviour. Thus they also say: Now we know that you know all things (John 16:30). Nevertheless, some give this passage a strained interpretation, applying it to just kings who do not judge appearances according to flattery, but diligently seek the truth of a case.

But he shall judge. Here his impartiality in carrying out justice is shown.

First, regarding the good, he grants them what is their due. He shall judge on the day of judgment, and even now: the Father has entrusted all judgment to the Son (John 5:22). These are the poor of whom Matthew 5:3 speaks: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

Second, regarding the wicked: first, their members. He shall strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, that is, those who dwell upon the earth: Depart from me, you who are accursed, into the eternal fire (Matthew 25:41); and: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees (Matthew 23:13).

Regarding their head: with the breath of his lips, that is, by words expressing his wrath, he shall slay the wicked one, namely the Antichrist. The sinner shall be revealed, the son of perdition, who opposes and exalts himself above everything called God or worshipped (2 Thessalonians 2:3–4). Or this refers to the devil: Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out (John 12:31). All this can also be interpreted literally of just kings who put the ungodly to death through their decrees.

Finally, let us persevere in observing God's justice. May God gird our loins with his sword for battle and with faith—the trust that comes from God—through which we shall overcome, for we all belong to Christ, the King of justice. If we have done our best to love our enemies with charity, yet the outcome is still bad, let us entrust them to God. Our part is to keep to the teaching of Jesus.

homilies.title: 將臨期第四主日道理：希望與承行主旨
homilies.content:
今天的主題是希望。

作家魯迅就曾說過：「希望，本無所謂有，也無所謂無，這就像地上的路，其實地上本沒有路，人走多了，便成了路。」

人生的起點和終點：「出生」與「死亡」，每個人都一樣，真正有差別是中間的歷程。成功與失敗的航程，都是由同一碼頭啟航的；而人生的歷程，則是由一次又一次的轉折點構成的，問題在於，你有沒有真正緊緊捉牢每次轉向的機會。

機會到底在哪裡呢?我們每個人都知道要把握機會，把握住時間，把握住能夠獲取最大利益的機會。可惜的是，人們沒有把這件事情放在創造我們的主身上。但主因著對世人的愛。祂利用苦難，例如我們從前所熟知的:洪水滅世、法老王的十個災難、達味王因驕傲而人口普查慘遭天主降怒，三天瘟疫。

在這種種的經驗中，都是說明了，若我們遠離了天主。這些災禍必然降下。

這裡也有一個很好的例子來說明:有信主的學者就這麼說過，到底這個世界上最大的災禍是怎樣造成的呢?是天主給的嗎?其實不盡然，在天主的智慧所要求的是人人彼此相愛、行善避惡。所以就是，人自找的，這世上若天主暫時的好像遺棄了世人，讓世人自己管理，就造成無法無天。目中無人，每個心中只想著自己，所以戰爭、貧富差距，就越來越嚴重的。一切都是人自己脫離的天主，自立為王的下場。每天的新聞都能告訴我們，這樣的事情。

那麼這世間的希望在哪?沒有。只能寄望在天上。

如果人們有三個願望可以實現。究竟我們希望的是甚麼呢?一般來說最想要就是解決當下的痛苦、或是回到最快樂的時候，但是有沒有人想過說:三個願望都是選擇呈行主旨呢?

將臨期已經快要結束了，而聖誕節的高峰就要來到，救主即將來臨。吾主要親自給你們一個徵兆：看，有位貞女要懷孕生子，給他起名叫厄瑪奴耳。意思就是天主與我們同在。

他與我們同在，說明了耶穌來要取人性，祂成了可以見的天主，並且見到他的人不會死亡。不像舊約一樣，若看見天主的人必然死去。相反的是，祂要帶來光明、生命。這生命是為了所有的人做補贖，才得到的生命。因為罪惡使人遠離天主，即使是有一點最小的罪若不淨化也不能與天主想永福。罪是可怕的事情，我們可以想想，別人得罪我們的時候的心情。尤其是當我們真心為一個人付出的時候，但所得到的回饋，卻是辱罵、謊言、甚至受到身心靈的傷害。我們到底會多麼生氣、難過、憤怒、絕望呢?而我們卻還是罪人，就有這樣一個自尊心，其實我們到底算什麼?

而天主，至高無上，從無中造成我們。祂的能力只需一言我們就無影無蹤，甚至在歷史上也找不到我們的蹤跡。但為什麼天主不這樣把得罪祂的所有人立即毀滅。經上紀載:因為祂愛上的祂自己的受造物、因為他不願人人喪亡，只願人人悔改得永生、因為浪子願意回頭改過、因為一個罪人悔改，這種快樂比有九十九個義人得的快樂更大。就是因為天主是愛。

最後，耶穌的到來，正如希伯來人書所說的:公牛和公山羊的血斷不能除免罪過。為此，基督一進入世界便說：「犧牲與素祭，已非你所要，卻給我預備了一個身體；全燔祭和贖罪祭，已非你所喜，於是我說：看，我已來到！關於我，書卷上已有記載：天主！我來為承行你的旨意。」

願聖母幫助我們，把我們全部的希望正如耶穌的希望。也與耶穌一起說:天主!我的希望就是承行你的旨意。

homilies.title: 從抱怨到見證：等待天主的恩寵
homilies.content:
「抱怨」是每個人都有的經驗，甚至我們一只抱怨，抱怨到後面連我們自己都不喜歡，因為我們不愛別人總是在說話的過程中只是批評別人，講述對ＸＸ事的不滿。所以既然我們討厭”抱怨:這件事，為什麼我們還一直去抱怨呢？

「抱怨」可能小到覺得晚餐很難吃，大到覺得父母怎麼可以對自己那麼壞，天主為什麼要讓這麻煩的事情發生、為什麼我對某某人那麼好，他就是不體諒我等等

當事情超乎自己預期，而沒辦法控制時，很多人會開始「抱怨」。但也有人把抱怨的底線設定為是否能讓自己開心，而當事情沒有讓他感到想像中的快樂時，他也會開始「抱怨」。這裡我們要想想是否遇到不如意的事情、痛苦的事情。真的只有抱怨可以解決嗎?是否當我們遇到痛苦的時候，卻能夠喜樂的去面對呢?可能有人會想:用講的當然容易。可是問題是:我們真的有努力去找取代方案嗎?

在今天的福音中:那時候，耶穌前行時，看見了一個生來瞎眼的人。

如果我們瞎眼的人，我們可以成為兩種不同的瞎子:一個是常常抱怨的瞎子；一個是靜靜地等待天主恩寵的瞎子。

福音中的盲人是怎樣的一個人呢?我們該說是後者:等待天主恩寵的那一個人。

一個人之所以有生病或痛苦。是因著原罪的影響。福音中的瞎子也是告訴我們人類的處境。第一人因罪而失明，我們都是他的子子孫孫：也就是說，人從出生就像是個瞎子。

關於門徒想問的問題，也是因為我們的主在治好癱瘓的人時說："看，你已經好了，不要再犯罪了。他們也想到可能那人是因為犯罪而患上了癱瘓才問:辣彼，誰犯了罪？是他，還是他的父母，竟使他生來瞎眼呢？這句話也很像我們一般人所想的父母所生的小孩之所以難帶或時常忤逆父母就是因為上輩子的債沒有還完。但這兩者都不可能是他失明的原因。前者，因為他一出生就瞎了；後者，罪惡不會有繼承的問題。正如厄則克爾書說:誰犯罪，誰就該喪亡；兒子不承擔父親的罪過，父親不承擔兒子的罪過。

我們繼續關於等待恩寵的盲人:這個盲人在聽到這些話時，沒有多做回應只是靜靜地聽。之後耶穌，便吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和了些泥，把泥抹在瞎子的眼上，對他說：「去，到史羅亞水池裡洗洗吧！」

我們的主在地上吐唾沫，用唾沫做泥巴，因為他是道成肉身的那一位。這個人在受到主的塗抹時並沒有立即看見；也就是說，他只是一個慕道者。但當他被送到稱為史羅亞的池子裏，也就是說，他在基督裏受了洗；然後他就得到了重生。史羅亞解說「被派遣的」；因為，如果他沒有被派遣，沒有引到基督身邊，就沒有人能夠從罪惡中解脫出來。

最後，這個復原的盲人他不會為自己以前的失明感到羞恥，他看到了天主，也沒有對耶穌向祂抱怨為什麼自己從小就這麼慘等等，凡而是他大膽的宣講賜予他重見光明的那一位。他不管人們怎麼看他，也不害怕法利賽人的斥責。他以他的生活去見證天主是怎樣幫助了他。

可能我們會覺得傳福音很難，也許是因為我們沒有細心觀察主在我們生活中到底做了什麼?只注意到所缺少的而有所抱怨。看看這個復原的盲人成了一个宣扬恩寵的人，一个传道人，向犹太人作了见证。這也應驗了主說所說:，叫那些看不見的，看得見；叫那些看得見的，反而成為瞎子。

願聖母幫助我們在這四旬期中，當我們抱怨時能夠想到十字架正是我們得救的武器。只管靜靜等待天主的恩寵到來。

homilies.title: 換上基督的眼光：先看自己的大樑
homilies.content:
我們知道眼睛是來看東西的。但我們通常會去看別人不對的地方。

眼睛是跟著我們的心，我們的心若處於黑暗，那其實我們的眼睛其實也是瞎的。

我們的生命，非常容易就被世界影響。如果我們不小心，我們就會進入這一個黑暗的世界。我們的時間總是會被剝奪。原本該陪伴小孩的時間，卻用來上網、玩手機。其實這並不是因為我們犯罪，而是因為世界的潮流。

在今天的福音中:耶穌，世界的光。他今天照耀了瞎子，讓我們想一下，這個瞎子他為什麼能夠開口去跟法利賽人講話。是因為原本他就是勇敢的嗎?不太可能。

人啊，通常是以一方面來判斷很多東西。所以事情總是沒有我們所想的一樣。若我們需要全面地來看事情的本質。我們需要帶上基督的視角。天主的視角是甚麼?

愛，如果我們有愛的話，我們所看到的不是那個人的問題。而是需要。

我們常聽到最可惡的人，其他他正是最可悲的人。我們會覺得他很可憐，所以才可以用寬恕。

今天的福音要我們換鏡子，換上基督的鏡子。現在，讓我們反省自己，到底自己有甚麼問題?

若我們不謙遜、不謙卑那其實我們根本就找不出自己有什麼問題。因為對於一個自己以為是完美的人，所有的缺點、醜陋根本也是完美。又或者也覺得自己的缺點是可以原諒的，別人的缺點不可原諒。

沒有看清自己大樑的人，根本不能幫助人取出別人的木屑。讓我先看看自己的大樑吧!

homilies.title: 第2主日道理：天主的羔羊，除免世罪者
homilies.content:
時期一滿，天主就派遣了自己的兒子，生於女人，生於法律之下，為把在法律之下的人救贖出來，使我們獲得義子的地位。

這就是「天主子耶穌基督的福音」：天主眷顧了祂的子民，實現了祂向亞巴郎及其後裔所許下的承諾。祂所做的遠遠超過一切期待——祂派遣了自己的「愛子」。

洗者若翰看見耶穌向他走來，便說：「看，天主的羔羊，除免世罪者！」

關於羔羊，我們首先必須知道，聖殿中奉獻的祭牲有五種：三種走獸，即牛犢、綿羊和山羊；兩種飛禽，即斑鳩和鴿子。在這三種走獸中，他只提到羔羊。羔羊每天都要奉獻，早上一次，晚上一次。因此，除了與基督相稱的羔羊之外，沒有別的動物足以表達這每天不斷奉獻的祭獻。

人的靈魂與屬於塵世、粗重的身體結合，幾乎不可能單憑自身，便達到完美的德行並完成天主的計畫。

但藉著聖言——天主的羔羊——的降生，許多事情將能在基督內得到成全，使我們所做的事不再徒勞。天主以大司祭的身分在我們內奉獻祭獻，而這祭獻完全出於對我們的愛。因為祂承擔了我們的憂苦，除去了世界的罪，並如同接受洗禮一般經歷死亡。

祂為什麼如此行呢？因為天主是正義的，有罪惡之處就應得到糾正。又因為一切罪惡都冒犯天主，其應受的懲罰也就相對更為嚴重。

關於「看，除免世罪者」，若翰並沒有說「將要除免」，而是說「除免世罪者」，彷彿祂一直在做這件事。祂不僅在受難時除去了罪，而且從那時直到現在，仍不斷除免罪惡。這並不是說祂不斷被釘在十字架上，因為祂只為罪奉獻了一次祭獻；而是祂藉著那一次祭獻，不斷洗淨罪惡。

為什麼他談到世界的罪，而不只是談到罪本身呢？因為他要普遍地表達罪惡，正如我們常說「人被逐出天堂」，所指的是整個人類。

或者更確切地說，「世罪」指的是全世界共有的原罪；這裡所說的是原罪，而不是每個人個別所犯的罪，後者則是基督藉著恩寵所赦免的。

因此，關於洗禮是否有效，關鍵不在於施洗者是否聖善，而在於洗禮的禱詞、基督的能力，以及領洗者的內心。無論由聖人還是罪人施洗，都沒有不同，因為這能力來自基督。

若望福音所強調的，是洗者若翰為耶穌作證，以及他如何藉著天主所給的記號認出耶穌。本主日的福音選自若望福音1:29–34；就形式而言，這段經文是洗者若翰的「獨白」。聖史沒有具體說明若翰在向誰說話，而在若望福音1:34中，他使用完成式：「我已看見了，我便作證：祂是天主子。」這種特別的敘述方式，強調若翰見證的持久效力，超越時間與空間。

願聖母使我們明白天主羔羊的愛，以及祂為世界的罪承受了何等深重的苦難。

en.title: Second Sunday in Ordinary Time: The Lamb of God Who Takes Away the Sin of the World
en.content:
But when the time had fully come, God sent forth his Son, born of a woman, born under the law, to redeem those who were under the law, so that we might receive adoption as sons.

This is 'the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God': God has visited his people. He has fulfilled the promise he made to Abraham and his descendants. far beyond all expectation - he has sent his own 'beloved Son'

When John the Baptist saw Jesus coming to him,he said:'Look, there is the lamb of God that takes away the sin of the world.

Concerning the lamb, first we must  know that five animals were offered in the temple, three beasts, a calf, a sheep and a goat; two kinds of fowl, a turtledove and a dove; of the kinds of sheep,  of these three he mentions only the lamb; the lamb was offered daily, once in the morning and once in the evening. So apart from the lamb, which is appropriate to Christ, no other animal is adequate to describe this daily sacrifice, the daily sacrifice.

It is almost impossible for men's souls, being united with earthly and gross bodies, to achieve perfect virtue and the plan of God on their own.

But by the birth of the Word, the Lamb of God, we will be able to have so many things made perfect through Christ that doing things will no longer be in vain. God offers a sacrifice in us as a high priest, and in this sacrifice it is only for love of us. For he bore our sorrows, took away the sins of the world, and experienced death as if by baptism.

Why did he do what he did? Because God is righteous, and where there is sin, it should be corrected. And because all sin is directed against God, and most of all its punishment is relatively more severe.

Concerning Behold Him Who takes away the sin of the world: he didn’t say, who will take the, but, Who takes away the sin of the world; as if He were always doing this. For He did not then only take it away when He suffered, but from that time to the present, He takes it away; not by being always crucified, for He made one sacrifice for sins, but by ever washing it by means of that sacrifice.

Why does he speak of the sins of the world and not just of sin? Because he wanted to express sin universally: as we usually say, man being cast out of heaven; referring to the whole human race.

Or rather, the sin of the world refers to the original sin common to the whole world: this is saying original sin, and not about the sin of each individual, which Christ forgives by his grace.

So as regards the validity of baptism, it is not whether the person baptizing is holy or not, but the prayer of baptism, the power of Christ, and the heart of the person to be baptized, so that it does not matter whether one is baptized by a saint or by a sinner, for the power is because of Christ.

About the emphasis, gospel of John is on John the baptist witness to Jesus and how he recognises Jesus through the sign given by God. This Sunday's Gospel is taken from John 1:29-34, and in its form the passage is a 'monologue' of John the Baptist. The evangelist does not specify to whom he is speaking, and in John 1:34 he uses the perfect tense: "I (have) seen, and I testify: He is the Son of God. This particular narrative emphasises the enduring validity of John's testimony, which transcends time and space.

May Our Lady make us understand the love of the Lamb of God and how much he has suffered for the sins of the world.

homilies.title: 第7主日道理：寬恕與愛仇人
homilies.content:
提起中國人的性格，大多數人都覺得中國人柔順可欺，缺乏血性而具奴性，但事實真的如此嗎？人們常常用以德報怨來形容一個人心胸寬廣，也是為人所稱讚的道德，並且廣泛的認為是儒家的觀點，但事實如此嗎？《論語·憲問》：或曰："以德報怨，何如？"子曰："何以報德？以直報怨，以德報德。"

原憲問孔子說"以善行回報惡行怎麼樣？"孔子回答說"如果以善行回報惡行？那用什麼來回報善行呢？所以我們應該用相同的方法回報惡行，用善行回報善行。"孔子的回答與西方社會的"對等報復原則"基本上是一致的（《舊約全書·申命記》記載"以眼還眼，以牙還牙，以手還手，以腳還腳）。

因為即使基督也沒有向在法官面前打他的人轉過臉去。而是當場提出了疑問:我若說得不對，你指證那裏不對；若對，你為什麼打我？（若望福音18）；當聖保祿被人打嘴時，他不僅沒有轉出他的臉，反而竭力反抗，甚至還說了一些嚴厲的話:粉白的牆啊！天主將要打擊你；（宗 23）等等......

所以在今天的福音中:不要抵抗惡人；而且，如果有人打你的右頰，你把左頰也轉給他。

我們可以從先前的例子中瞭解到，基督在這裡教導的要麼不是規定，要麼我們不應該像字面暗示，有其額外意思。因為如果它是一個規定，而且該遵守按字面意思。基督和聖保祿都會去遵守。所以事實上該說一部分是規定，一部分是一個忠告。

關於規定這話在於：

一、不尋報復。

二、另一面也轉給他；也就是說，接受傷害而不是報復已經受到的傷害。正如基督向打他的人所說的:我若說得不對，你指證那裏不對?

這裡基督所針對的不是打不打臉的回答，而是要求對方給予一個真理的答覆。

三、第三，當仁慈和愛德對事情有需要時，我們需要隨時放棄自己的權利。這是一個忠告，雖然愛德和天主的愛都沒有絕對要求我們這樣做，但我們確實應該為自己的補贖而做。

是阿，挑釁我們、對我們造成傷害的人要置我們於死地，但卻可以愛了愛基督、為自身的補贖反而欣然接受這苦。正如聖樂倫執事，他對把他放在烤架上的人說:已經煮好了，可以開始吃了。樂輪執事的表情就當時的人來說，可以用欣喜若狂來形容。是他已經瘋掉了嗎?還是他根本沒感覺。都不是。

因為他的早就答應總是回應基督的愛，所以這絕大的痛苦，正是他回應基督的愛的絕佳機會。

雖然耶穌的道理，對我們來說不是陌生的了。甚至不是教友的人，也都會來開關於打臉的玩笑。說起來很容易，其實當我們被人傷害、污辱甚至自己的家人、又或著自己討厭的人。要停止這報復該說是相當的難。心中的氣總是難以消除。

原諒需要練習，從小的原諒就要練習。在每次受到的傷害，我們都要在心裡說:主阿，原諒非常的難，請祢幫我原諒他人，我把報復權力交在你手中；又或著我們該想想，我們總是容易犯罪使耶穌傷心，耶穌都原諒我們，我們又有甚麼理由不原諒?

最後，主常以同情心來原諒我們，而不是因為看到我們跌倒就感到快樂，即使我們傷害了祂。主要告訴我們，報復只能讓人身處黑暗，即便使最小的，黑暗就一只在那，平安也不再那。

願聖母教導我們寬恕他人的傷害，使我們走出黑暗並朝向恩寵的光芒。

homilies.title: 單-常年期第1週星期五道理：以信德與犧牲彼此代禱
homilies.content:
祈禱是我們每天的功課，對我們而言並不陌生，正如身體需要空氣，靈魂也需要祈禱。然而，很多時候，我們沒有力量祈禱，或因懶惰，或覺得天主的恩寵不夠。在那個時候，我們實在一點也不想祈禱，祈禱成了負擔，只想什麼都不做。

因此，讓我們不要忘記，我們也需要別人幫助我們祈禱，就如他們為我們送來氧氣瓶，使我們的靈魂重新充滿新鮮的空氣。

今天的福音說：耶穌正向他們講道時，有人帶著一個癱子到祂跟前，由四個人抬著。

當我們軟弱無力時，就像這個癱子；而那四個人，就是一直為我們祈禱的人。

接著，他們在耶穌所在之處上方拆開屋頂，開了一個洞。這告訴我們，幫助朋友不能只是口頭說說，而要把助人的決心付諸實行；在這個過程中，我們也需要作出一些犧牲。

最後，耶穌看見他們的信德，不但治好了癱子，也赦免了他的罪。這裡所指的不是病人的信德，而是抬他來的人所具有的信德；因為有時候，一個人會因另一個人的信德而獲得治癒，也就是因朋友的信德而得到幫助。

別人的信德竟然有如此大的影響，使這人立刻站起來，身心都得到治癒，並因一人的功勞，使另一人的罪得到赦免。由此可見，每個人自身的信德，在天主前具有何等重要的分量。

願聖母使我們明白，犧牲也是幫助他人不可缺少的一部分。

en.title: Odd-Friday of the First Week in Ordinary Time: Faith, Sacrifice, and Praying for One Another
en.content:
Prayer is a daily task for us. It is not new to us, just as the body needs air, and the soul needs prayer. But very often, we don't have the strength to pray, or we are lazy, or or we feel that God's graces is not enough. At that time, we really don't want to pray at all, prayer becomes a burden and we just want to do nothing.

So let's not forget that we also need other people to help us pray, just as they help us to bring oxygen tank to fill our souls with new air.

In today's Gospel: Jesus was preaching the word to them when some people came bringing him a paralytic carried by four men.

When we are powerless, we are like this paralytic. And these four men were the ones who always prayed for us.

And then they stripped the roof over the place where Jesus was, and they had made an opening. it is telling us that in order to help a friend, it is not just a matter of talking about it but of practising our determination to help, and that this process requires some sacrifice on our part.

In the end Jesus Seeing their faith not only healed the paralytic but also forgave him his sins. He did not mean the faith of the sick man, but of his bearers; for it sometimes happens that a man is healed by the faith of another. Or we say the faith of our friends.

It may indeed be seen how much each person's own faith weighs with God, when that of another had such influence that the whole man at once rose up , healed body and soul, and by one man's merit, The sins of another should be forgiven.

May Our Lady make us understand that sacrifice is also a necessary part of helping people.

homilies.title: 單-常年期第2週星期三道理：伸出手來，領受主的仁慈
homilies.content:
猶太人指責主的門徒在安息日掐取麥穗充飢，因此主以達味的事例，使他們明白其中的真理；接著又藉一個奇蹟，向他們顯明祂所做的，是為實現安息日的真義，而不是破壞安息日。主告訴我們，在安息日為人的健康而施行奇蹟，是虔敬的行為；在安息日為身體的健康而行事，並不是壞事。

因此，既然主如此教導，我們的主日彌撒也是我們的安息日。若是為了照顧病人，我們便可免除相關的責任。

法利賽人知道耶穌會治好那人，便故意向祂挑戰。於是，耶穌含怒環視他們。

祂含怒環視他們，並因他們的盲目而憂傷，這符合祂的人性，也顯示耶穌願意承擔我們的痛苦。祂要向我們顯示祂的話語何等有力，並證明祂就是生活的聖言。正如天主以一句話創造萬有，耶穌也要藉自己的話語施行奇蹟：

於是，祂對那人說：「伸出手來！」

「他一伸出來，他的手就復了原。」耶穌藉這些事回答門徒，同時也表明祂的生命高於法律。祂要藉自己的話語，賜給人更豐盛的生命。

但從奧祕的角度來看，那個手枯乾的人，代表人在善行上結果子的能力已經枯萎，如今卻藉著上主的仁慈而獲得治癒。

當我們的原祖父母摘取禁樹的果實時，人的手便枯乾了；而救主在十字架的木上伸出祂無罪的手，藉祂的恩寵，使這隻手重新得到善行的滋養，恢復健康。

最後，讓我們反省：我們是否有時也像法利賽人一樣，看待耶穌在我們生命中的安排？我們是否也覺得，主不應當如此安排，因為這樣會違反我們自己所定的規則？

願聖母帶領我們，明白上主對我們的愛。

en.title: Odd-Wednesday of the Second Week in Ordinary Time: Stretch Out Your Hand and Receive the Lord’s Mercy
en.content:
The Jews accused the Lord's disciples of plucking ears of corn on the Sabbath to feed their hunger, so the Lord used the example of David to make them understand the truth, and then showed them by a miracle that he was doing it for the truth of the Sabbath and not to destroy it. The Lord tells us that it is a pious act to perform miracles on the Sabbath for the health of the people, and that it is not a bad thing to do on the Sabbath for the health of the body.

So because the Lord has said so, our Sunday Mass is also our Sabbath. If we take care of the sick we are exempt from responsibility.

So the Pharisees knew that Jesus would heal him and they challenged him on purpose. So Jesus looked angrily round at them.

He looked angrily round at them, saddened by their blindness, which is in keeping with human nature and Jesus' willingness to bear our suffering. He wants to show us how powerful his words are and how he wants to prove that he is the living Word. Just as God created all things with one word, so Jesus wants to do miracles with his word:

So he said to the man, 'Stretch out your hand.

"He stretched it out and his hand was better.". Jesus answered the disciples through these things, and at the same time made it clear that his life was higher than the law. And by his words he would give people a richer life.

But from a mystical point of view, the man with the withered hand represents a human being whose fruitfulness in good works had dried up, but who is now healed through the mercy of the Lord;

the human hand, which had dried up when our first parents plucked the fruit of the forbidden tree, was restored to health through the sap of good works by the grace of the Saviour, who stretched out his sinless hand on the tree of the cross.

Finally, let us reflect on whether we sometimes look at what Jesus has ordained in our lives in the same way as the Pharisees? Do we not also feel that the Lord should not have arranged this in such a way that it would violate our own law?

May Our Lady lead us to understand the love of the Lord for us.

homilies.title: 單-常年期第3週星期五道理：天國的種子與自由意志
homilies.content:
《天主教教理》告訴我們，教會有三種狀態：「旅途中的教會」，或稱「戰鬥的教會」；已到達天堂、享有天主光榮的「凱旋的教會」；以及仍在煉獄中受苦、等待進入天堂的「受苦的教會」。這三者是同一個教會，只是處於不同的狀態。

今天福音中的天國比喻，是在講論教會。主以這個比喻談論那些得救的人，所以經上說：「天主的國好比一個人把種子撒在地裏。」不論黑夜白天，他或睡或起，種子發芽生長，至於怎樣，他卻不知道。

天主的國就是教會。教會由天主管理，也治理人，並克服那些反對她的勢力與一切邪惡。天主的國確實就像一個人撒種。這個人就是耶穌：祂是天主，也是天主子；祂保持自己的天主性不變而成為人，將種子撒在地上，也就是藉著使人認識天主的聖言，光照整個世界。

種子是耶穌的話，是生命的話；土地是人的心；那人的睡眠，則代表救主的死亡。種子日夜發芽生長，因為在基督安眠之後，基督徒的人數不斷增加；無論經歷災難或順境，他們的信德都日益茁壯，行為也在磨難與順境之後繼續成長。

關於「至於怎樣，他卻不知道」，主是在作一個比喻：祂不讓我們預先知道，我們當中誰會結果實，直到最後才會顯明。這也是提醒我們，要奮鬥到底。

或者，更確切地說，祂說「至於怎樣，他卻不知道」，是為了顯明領受聖言之人的自由意志。因為天主願意人自由地與祂的旨意合作，而不是由天主親自控制人，使人完成祂所有的意願，以免人誤以為天主早已預定了人的命運。

願聖母帶領我們，明白自由意志的真正意義。

en.title: Odd-Friday of the Third Week in Ordinary Time: The Seed of the Kingdom and Free Will
en.content:
The Catechism tells us that there are three states of the Church: the  (Pilgrim Church), or "Church Militant", and the (Church Triumphant), which has reached heaven and is enjoying the glory of God, and the "Church Suffering" , which is still suffering in purgatory and awaiting its ascension to heaven. These three are the same church,But different states

In today's Gospel, the parable of the Kingdom of God is talking about the Church.He puts forth a parable concerning those only who are saved.Wherefore it is said, “This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man throws seed on the land.”Night and day, while he sleeps, when he is awake, the seed is sprouting and growing; how, he does not know.

The kingdom of God is the Church, which is ruled by God, rules over men herself, and steps down the forces that are opposed (əˈpəʊzd)to her and all evil.The kingdom of God indeed is as if a man should throw seed. This man is Jesus he is God and the Son of God, having without change been and become man, has cast seed upon the earth, that is saying, He has enlightened the whole world by the word of divine knowledge.

The seed is the word of Jesus is word of live, the ground is the human heart, and the sleep of the man means the death of the Saviour. The seed springs up night and day, because after the sleep of Christ, the number of Christians, through calamity (kəˈlæməti) and prosperity (prɒˈsperəti) , continued to flourish more and more in faith, and grow in deeds after the tribulation and prosperity.

Regarding the "how, he does not know", he is making an analogy( əˈnælədʒi ); that is, he does not let us know who among us will bear fruit until the end.It is also a reminder to us  to fight to the end.

Or rather, He said "how, He does not know" to show the free will of those who receive the Word, for God wills that man should cooperate freely with His will, not that God Himself should control man in the accomplishment of all His will, lest men should misunderstand that God has predestinated the destiny of man.

May Our Lady lead us to understand the true meaning of free will.

homilies.title: 單-常年期第4週星期五道理：復活的盼望與面見天主
homilies.content:
今天的福音說：有人說：「洗者若翰從死者中復活了，因此才有這些奇能在他身上運行。」

我們信仰的基礎是復活，但我們對復活究竟認識多少呢？

有些人可能以為，復活就是享有極大的肉身快樂，或過著無憂無慮的生活。然而，最大的幸福並不在這些事上。正如聖經告訴我們：天主的國不在於吃喝；到了復活的時候，男女也不娶不嫁。

最大的幸福是面對面看見天主。有人可能會問，為什麼面對面看見天主就是最大的幸福呢？我們都有不明白事情的經驗，也都希望知道更多，好能做得更多，或解決更多問題。面對面看見天主，就是使我們無限的求知渴望得到滿足。藉著瞻仰無限的天主，我們彷彿能對萬事有無限更深的認識，也彷彿能把更多事情做得正確。

聖巴拉斯在被祝聖為主教之前，是一位具有奇妙醫治能力的醫師。許多奇蹟被歸於他的代禱，其中包括他在避難期間治癒患病野獸的事蹟，因此他也成為野生動物的主保。到了第六世紀，東方已尊他為喉疾患者的主保；在西方，這項敬禮則見於第九世紀。

自第十六世紀開始，聖巴拉斯的祝福禮至今仍在許多地方於他的慶日舉行。兩支蠟燭經祝福後，在會眾面前交叉放置；或以在油中祝聖的燈芯，觸碰信友的喉嚨。

願聖母堅固我們對復活的信德！

en.title: Odd-Friday of the Fourth Week in Ordinary Time: The Hope of Resurrection and Seeing God Face to Face
en.content:
In today’s Gospel:Some were saying, ‘John the Baptist has risen from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him.

The foundation of our faith is the resurrection, but how much do we know about it?

Some may think that it is about the great sense of physical pleasure. Or a life free from worry. But the greatest happiness is not in these things, as the Bible tells us: because the kingdom of God does not mean eating or drinking, for at the resurrection men and women do not marry.

The greatest happiness is to see God face to face. Some may wonder why seeing God face to face is the greatest happiness. We all have the experience of ignorance, of wanting to know more, so we can do more or solve more. To see God face to face is to satisfy our infinite desire to know. By seeing the infinite God, we can become as if we know infinitely more about everything, and we can also become as if we can do infinitely more right.

before Blaise was made bishop, he was a physician possessed of wonderful healing power. Numerous miracles were attributedəˈtrɪbjuːtɪd  to him, including ɪnˈkluːdɪŋ the cure of diseased beasts during his refuge, thus accounting for his also being the patron saint of wild animals. He was venerated as the patron of sufferers from throat diseases in the East by the 6th century and in the West by the 9th century.

Begun in the 16th century, the blessing of St. Blaise is a ceremonyˈserəməni still practiced and celebrated on his feast day in many places. Two candles are consecrated and crossed before the congregation; or a wick, consecrated in oil, is touched to the throats of the faithful.

May Our Lady strengthen our faith in the Resurrection!

homilies.title: 單-常年期第5週星期五道理：厄法達，開了罷
homilies.content:
有人給耶穌帶來一個又聾又啞的人，求祂給他覆手。耶穌領他離開群眾，來到一旁。

耶穌不願公開施行奇蹟，是為教導我們，一切奇蹟都來自天主。祂把手指放進那人的耳朵，是要顯示天主的第二位與人的肉身結合，因此祂所做的一切，都與天主的德能有關。

也正因為亞當的過犯，人類的肢體與感官遭受許多痛苦，基督才來到世界，在自己身上顯示人性的完美。因此，祂用手指開啟人的耳朵，並藉自己的唾液賜下說話的能力。

祂要顯示，祂聖體上的所有肢體都是神聖的，甚至連使舌結鬆開的唾液也是如此。因為唾液不過是身體多餘的水分，但在上主內，一切都是聖的。

然後，祂望天嘆息，向那人說：「厄法達！」就是說：「開了罷！」

祂同時嘆息，是因為祂承擔了我們所犯的一切罪，憐憫人類，也看見人類正遭受罪惡的污染。

那人的耳朵便開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。耶穌囑咐他們，不要把這事告訴任何人。祂藉此教導我們，不要誇耀自己的能力，而要以自己的十字架與屈辱為榮。祂也要求他們隱瞞這個奇蹟，以免猶太人因嫉妒而在祂的時辰未到之前，便想殺害祂。

願聖母帶領我們，開啟以天主的眼光看事物的窗戶。

en.title: Odd-Friday of the Fifth Week in Ordinary Time: Ephphatha, Be Opened
en.content:
They brought him a deaf man who had an impediment in his speech; and they asked him to lay his hand on him.  He took him aside in private, away from the crowd.

Jesus did not want to do miracles in public in order to teach us that all miracles come from God. When he put his finger in his ear, it was to show that the second person of God's Divine nature was united with human flesh, so that everything he did was related to divine virtue.

It was also because of Adam's transgression that humanity suffered so much in its members and senses and that Christ came into the world, that he showed in himself the perfection of humanity and thus opened the ear with his finger and gave power of speech with his saliva.

He wants to show that all the members of His holy body are divine, even the saliva that loosens the cords of the tongue. For saliva is only the excess water of the body, but in the Lord all things are holy.

Then looking up to heaven he sighed; and he said to him, ‘Ephphatha’, that is, ‘Be opened.

He sighs at the same time because he takes upon himself all the sins we commit, he has compassion on humanity and sees the pollution of sin that it is suffering.

And his ears were opened, and the ligament of his tongue was loosened and he spoke clearly. And Jesus ordered them to tell no one about it.By this He teaches us not to boast in our own power, but in our cross and humiliation. He also asked them to conceal this miracle, lest he should provoke the Jews to kill him before his time out of envy.

May Our Lady lead us to open the window of divine vision

homilies.title: 單-常年期第6週星期五道理：背起十字架，跟隨基督
homilies.content:
也許我們都聽過那個為了方便而鋸短自己十字架的人的故事。他為了方便，把原本的十字架鋸短了。因為拋棄了「對自己沒有用處的壓力」，他的生活變得比較輕鬆。

結果如何呢？他不斷減輕自己的十字架，過著快樂、順遂的生活，或許還被人稱為聰明人。但後來發生了一件令人悲傷的事：有一天，他來到天主面前，卻發現自己與天主相隔甚遠。上主對他說：「把你的十字架放下來罷！這樣你就能到我這裡來。」可惜，他的十字架已經太短了。我們都能想像，他後來會有怎樣的結果。

今天的福音告訴我們：

人縱然賺得了全世界，卻賠上了自己的生命，究竟有什麼益處呢？

耶穌彷彿在說：不要以為逃避十字架危險的人，就救了自己的靈魂。因為一個人若交出自己的靈魂、自己的生命，藉此賺得全世界，靈魂卻正在喪亡，他究竟得到了什麼？難道他還有另一個靈魂可以交換嗎？人可以用房屋的價款換取一棟房屋，但當他失去自己的靈魂時，就沒有另一個靈魂可以交付了。

背十字架是痛苦的，但我們仍應背負它。因為即使我們不願意背，它仍然存在於我們的生活中。若我們現在不背，將來仍要背負。

令人欣慰的是，我們是與耶穌一起背十字架，而祂將在未來賜給我們永恆的安慰。正如經上所說：「誰若願意跟隨我，該棄絕自己，背著自己的十字架，跟隨我……必要救得自己的生命。」

背起十字架之後，我們也需要獲得新的力量。重要的是，我們必須跟隨耶穌。因為人可能承受了痛苦，卻沒有跟隨基督，那麼他的痛苦便成了徒然。

因此，那些在看見天主的國帶著威能來到以前，決不會嘗到死味的人，究竟是誰呢？會是我們嗎？

願聖母幫助我們，看見十字架的真正意義。

en.title: Odd-Friday of the Sixth Week in Ordinary Time: Take Up Your Cross and Follow Christ
en.content:
Maybe we have all heard the story of the man who sawed off his cross for convenience. He sawed off his original cross for convenience. His life was easier because it threw away "the pressure that was not useful to him".

what is the result? He lived a life of constant reduction of the cross, a life of happiness, a life of good fortune, as one might say, as a wise man. But then a sad thing happened, one day he came to God, and he was so far away from God. The Lord said to him, "Put down your cross! Then you can come to me. Unfortunately, his cross was too short. We can all imagine what happened to him afterwards.

The gospel today tells us:

What gain, then, is it for a man to win the whole world and ruin his life?

Jesus seems to be saying, "Do not think that the man who avoids the danger of the cross has saved his soul; for when a man gives his soul, his life, and thereby gains the whole world, but his soul is perishing, what has he gained? Does he have another soul to replace it? A man may exchange the price of his house for a house, but when he loses his soul, he has no other soul to give.

Carrying the cross is painful, but we should carry it. Because even if we don't want to carry it, it is still in our lives. If we don't carry it now, we will have to carry it in the future.

The happy thing is that we are carrying the cross with Jesus. And He will give us eternal comfort in the future. As the Scripture says:‘If anyone wants to be a follower of mine, let him renounce himself and take up his cross and follow me......will save it。

After carrying the cross, we must be given new strength. It is important that we follow Jesus. For it may happen that a person may suffer and not follow Christ, so that person's suffering is in vain.

therefore, who are those , will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God come with power?Are we?

May Our Lady help us to see the true meaning of the cross

homilies.title: 單-常年期第22週星期五道理：禁食、愛德與敞開自我
homilies.content:
若翰的門徒來到耶穌跟前，說：「為什麼我們和法利賽人都禁食，而祢的門徒卻不禁食呢？」

洗者若翰的門徒從心裡相信若翰的話，也知道若翰曾譴責法利賽人，並尊重耶穌。

耶穌明白他們話語背後的意思：他們不是要譴責耶穌，而是真心想知道，為什麼祂的門徒沒有經常禁食。

其實，若翰的門徒想說的是：主啊，祢是靈性的醫師，祢不禁食是自然的事，但祢的門徒為什麼也不禁食呢？

首先，我們必須知道，洗者若翰不喝淡酒和烈酒，是要藉著禁食加強節制，並藉節制增長功勞與德行。然而，耶穌是天上的天主，是新以色列的新郎，具有無限的能力，是德行的主，也是赦免罪過者。

因此，門徒為什麼不能因著耶穌而與罪人一起吃飯，並藉此獲得正義與德行呢？不與罪人一起吃飯，反而會缺少愛德。基督禁食，是為教導我們禁食與祈禱的重要；祂與罪人一起吃飯，則是為彰顯祂的能力與恩惠。

禁食是可取的，但作為向天主表達虔敬的方式，並不是對每一個人、在每一個時刻都合適，例如赴婚宴時就不適宜。每個人的處境都不同：在同一時刻，有人喜樂，也有人悲傷。每個人都只能在自己的處境與時間裡，以自己獨特的方式與天主建立關係。

我們快樂時可以讚美天主，悲傷時也可以向祂哭訴。即使同樣是引領罪人悔改，耶穌與若翰的做法也不同：一位藉友誼與罪人吃喝，另一位則以身作則，要求他們禁食悔改。唯有不再以自己的標準衡量別人，我們才能與萬民之父相遇，並發現天主遠遠超過我們在小井底所見的那一小片天空。

願聖母幫助我們敞開自我，專心聆聽每一位弟兄姊妹的需要。

en.title: Odd-Friday of the Twenty-Second Week in Ordinary Time: Fasting, Charity, and Opening Ourselves to Others
en.content:
John's disciples came to Jesus and said, 'Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast, but your disciples do not?

The disciples of John the Baptist believed John's words from the heart, and knew that John condemned the Pharisees and respected Jesus.

Jesus knew the meaning behind their words, not to condemn Jesus, but really to find out why His disciples did not fast regularly.

In fact, what John's disciples were trying to say was: Lord, it is natural that you, as a spiritual physician, should not fast, but why do your disciples not fast?

First of all, we need to know that the reason John the Baptist did not drink light and strong wine was to increase his abstinence by fasting. It was to increase his merit and virtue by abstinence. But Jesus is the God of heaven, the Bridegroom of the new Israel, infinitely powerful, the Lord of virtue, and the forgiver of sins.

So why not eat with sinners because of Jesus, so that His disciples can gain righteousness and virtue by doing so? It would have been without of charity not to eat with sinners. Christ fasted in order to teach us the importance of fasting and prayer, and he ate with sinners in order to show us his power and favour.

Fasting is desirable, but as a way of showing devotion to God, it is not appropriate for everyone at all times, for example, not when attending a wedding feast. Everyone's situation is different: at the same moment, some people rejoice, others grieve. Each person can only relate to God in his or her own unique way, in his or her own situation and time.

We can praise God when we are happy and we can cry to Him when we are sad. Even in the same way of bringing sinners to repentance, Jesus and John did it differently: one ate and drank with sinners through friendship, and the other asked them to fast and repent through example. It is only when we stop measuring others by our own standards that we can meet the Father of all men and discover that God is much more than the small piece of sky we see at the bottom of little wells.

May Our Lady help us to open our egos to hear only the needs of every brothers and sisters.

homilies.title: 諸聖節道理
homilies.content:
教會由初期開始，就一直有冊封(caak3fung1)聖人的傳統。由聖斯德望、十二位宗徒，到教會聖師，例如聖奧斯定同聖額我略(ngaak6 ngo5 loek6)，全部都係我哋所敬仰嘅聖人。

我哋可能好容易將聖人睇成係舊時故事入面嘅人，因為我哋經常聽到嘅人，已經過咗幾百年，甚至一千幾年前嘅聖人。現代就冇聖人咩？當然唔係！教會而家仲有好多聖人，例如聖若望保祿二世、加爾各答( gaa1ji5 gok3daap3)嘅聖德蘭修女，以及聖卡洛．阿庫蒂斯。佢哋都向我哋傳達一個重要嘅訊息：耶穌基督必須係我哋生命嘅中心。

例如，聖卡洛．阿庫蒂斯曾經講一句非常有名嘅說話：「聖體聖事就係通往天堂嘅高速公路。」佢喺十五歲嗰年，因為疾病而離開咗我哋，但佢嘅遺體卻冇腐壞。天主透過佢向我哋傳達一個訊息：聖體聖事中嘅耶穌係真實臨在，祂願意一直同我哋在一起，直到世界嘅終結。

今日係諸聖節。喺一年入面，教會會喺唔同嘅日子紀念唔同嘅聖人。因此，喺禮儀年結束嘅時候，教會將所有已知同未知( mei6 zi1)、已經封聖或者尚未封聖嘅聖人聚埋一齊，隆重咁慶祝，係一件非常有意義嘅事。當然，呢個慶典亦都包括我哋已經離世( lei4sai3)嘅屋企人同朋友。

我哋幾乎可以肯定，佢哋當中亦都有人成為咗我哋喺天上嘅家人聖人。

諸聖節唔單止係為咗慶祝聖人，同時亦都係提醒我哋呢啲努力活出基督信仰嘅人：如果我哋願意為耶穌忍受痛苦，並且喺一切事上努力行善，我哋同樣都可以成為聖人。

成聖其實冇我哋想像中咁好似好遙遠(hou2ci5 hou2jiu4jyun5)。正如聖經所講：「天主嘅旨意就係要你哋成聖。」

最後，今日之後就係追思已亡節。諸聖節同追思已亡節都有非常深刻嘅意義。今日嘅慶典提醒我哋反省，亦都讓我哋期待，有一日能夠同天上嘅聖人一齊歡欣喜樂。

而聽日嘅追思已亡節就提醒我哋：如果我哋希望將來能夠同聖人一齊分享天上嘅喜樂，咁我哋喺仍然活喺世上嘅時候，就必須愛天主、愛近人，並且努力行善。

此外，我哋亦都應該為嗰啲仍然喺煉獄中等待淨化嘅親友祈禱。我哋可以為佢哋誦念經文、誦唸玫瑰經，亦可以為佢哋奉獻彌撒聖祭，祈求天主使佢哋早日進入天國。呢啲都係我哋愛天主、愛近人嘅具體表達。

願榮福童貞瑪利亞為我哋轉求，幫助我哋明白：人生最重要嘅事，就係依靠天主嘅恩寵，努力追求成聖就自己的靈魂。

homilies.title: 聖誕節道理：聖言與創造萬有的天主
homilies.content:
說話對我們而言是一件簡單的事，也是我們的本能。一般來說，說話是指「用言語表達一件事實或一種態度」，但也包括指責、批評、閒談、說理、協商等等。

言語可以表達尊重與誠實，可以教導、勸戒，也能醫治身心，帶來安慰與平安、興盛、祝福與幸福、健康與長壽。

言語也可能具有破壞性，例如批評與論斷、誹謗、詛咒、中傷、不經思考便隨口說出的話、爭論、驕傲的話、不義的話，以及辱罵。這些破壞性的言語就像毒蛇的毒液，又像刺傷人的利刃，使人生病、喪命，帶來不幸與痛苦，使人陷入罪惡。

既然言語具有某種力量，那麼天主為何能以一句話創造萬有，就不難理解了。因為天主的本性就是存有，而存有意味著現實，也意味著具有。

人卻不是如此，因為人具有潛能，所以人的言語不能具有真正的創造能力。天主是純粹的現實；祂的話語沒有潛能，只有現實。因此，天主能以祂的話語創造萬有。

今天的福音說：在起初已有聖言，聖言與天主同在，聖言就是天主。聖言在起初就與天主同在。萬物是藉著祂而造成的；凡受造的，沒有一樣不是由祂而造成的。

這是怎樣的聖言呢？這是永不消逝的聖言。祂不只是一個聲音，也不是說出來後便立即消失的話語；若是如此，萬物就不可能被創造出來。

言語有兩個層面：第一是聲音，第二是聲音所表達的意義。因此，當我談論天主時，哪個層面會觸動我們，或引起我們的關注呢？是第二個層面。「天主」這個詞使我們想到：生活的、永恆的、全能的、無限的、無所不在的。

主耶穌基督就是天主的聖言。因此，當我們想到聖言時，不應把祂當作任何普通的事物，因為祂也是天主。祂使萬物美好，使四季更替，使種子長成大樹。一切都因祂而存在；若沒有上主的聖言使這一切實現，萬物便歸於虛無。

現在，我們可以想像一個詞，例如「摩天大樓」。

當我們從下方仰望摩天大樓，或觀看聖伯多祿大殿，見到這樣的設計時，我們會驚嘆設計者的巧思。然而，天主的聖言更加奇妙。祂創造了天地，包括山嶺、海洋、四季的變化、各種植物與動物、宇宙中尚未被人知曉的奧祕，乃至天使；而我們只是其中一個小小的受造物。

這裡有一點十分重要：我們說萬物和一切受造物都是天主所造的，但罪惡不是上主所造的。天使是上主所造的，但魔鬼並不是；人是天主所造的，但惡人並不是。因為惡意味著善的缺乏。

世上有如此多的罪惡，天主只是容許它們發生，祂並不喜愛罪惡。天主賜給人與天使自由，可以跟隨祂，也可以離開祂。跟隨祂的人，是因為愛慕祂的恩寵；離開祂的人，則是不願意與祂的恩寵合作。邪惡的事並非天主所命定，而是出於人的意志。耶穌願意人人悔改，卻不願強迫人悔改。直到今天，天主仍不斷勸人悔改；祂從未停止工作，祂藉著電視、網路、神職人員、修道人士等等來勸導人……

願聖母幫助那些尚未真正認識耶穌的人，使他們在聖嬰的光照下重新悔改。

en.title: Christmas Homily: The Word and God Who Creates All Things
en.content:
Talking is a simple thing for us. It is our instinct. It generally means "to express a fact or express an attitude in words", but it also means to accuse, to criticise, to gossip, to reason, to negotiate, etc.

Words can be respectful, honest, instructive and reproving, healing (of the body and mind), bringing comfort and peace, prosperity, blessing and happiness, health and longevity.

Words that can also be destructive are criticism (judgement), slander, curses, slanderous words, casual words (speaking without thinking), arguments, proud words, words of injustice, words of abuse, these destructive words are like the venom of a poisonous snake, like a sharp knife that stabs a person, making them sick, killing them, causing them misfortune, causing them pain, causing them to They cause sickness, they cause death, misery, suffering, they cause people to fall into sin.

In that case, there is a certain power, So it is not difficult to understand why God can create all things with a single word. For the very nature of God is being.being means  act and means having.

This is not the case with human beings, who have potential. So words cannot have real creative power. God is pure reality, and words without potential can only be reality.So God can create all things by  his word.

In the Gospel today. In the beginning there was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. The Word was with God in the beginning. All things were made through him; nothing was made that was not made by him.

What kind of a word is this? It is a word that never fades. It is not just a voice, It is not a word that will disappear right away. If that were the case, then all things could not have been created.

There are two aspects to the word. The first is the sound. The second is the meaning of the sound. So when I talk about God, which aspect strikes us or interests us. It is the second aspect. The word God makes us think of the following: living, eternal, all-powerful, infinite, everywhere and everywhere.

The Lord Jesus Christ, is the Word of God. So when we think of the Word, it is not just any ordinary thing, He is also the God . He makes all things beautiful, the seasons change, the seeds grow into trees. All things come into being because of him. All is nothing without the Word of the Lord making it happen.

Now we can imagine a word. For example, the word "skyscraper".

When we look at the skyscraper from below, St Peter's Basilica. When we see such designs we marvel at the designer. And the Word of God is even more wonderful. He created the sky and the earth, they include the mountains, the sea, the changing seasons, the different kinds of plants and animals, and the unknown messages of the universe, even down to the angels, and we are just a small creation.

And it is important to note here that we said that everything and all creatures God making. But sin is not of the Lord's making: angels are of the Lord's making; but the devil is not. human being are made by God; but evil men are not. For evil means the lack of good.

There is so much sin and evil in the world that God only allows it to happen; he does not love it. God has given man and angels the freedom to follow Him or to leave Him. Those who follow Him do so because they love His graces; those who leave Him do so because they do not want to cooperate with His graces.Evil things are not ordained by God, but are done by the will of man. Jesus wants everyone to repent, but not to be forced to do so. To this day God is still persuading people to repent, He never stops working, He uses TV, the internet, clergy, monks, etc. ......

May Our Lady help those who have not yet truly known Jesus to repent again in the light of the Holy Child.

homilies.title: 單-將臨期第四週星期四道理：聖依撒伯爾的德行與若翰的名字
homilies.content:
聖依撒伯爾是一位德行高尚的婦女。因為對一位婦女而言，最重要的是能夠生育，而不是不孕。但天主為麗莎安排了一個特別的計畫。她的不孕並不是因為天主在懲罰她，而是天主在幫助她磨練德行。

到了第八天，他們來給孩子行割損禮，原想給他起名叫匝加利亞。為什麼是在行割損禮之後才給孩子命名呢？

因為除非人先捨棄肉身的私慾——這正是割損禮所象徵的——否則就不配使自己的名字被記在生命冊上。

天主沒有給他起名叫匝加利亞，是因為「匝加利亞」意指「記念天主」，而「若翰」意指「指出」。記念涉及不在眼前的事物，指出則涉及在眼前的事物。但若翰不是要使人記念一位不在眼前的天主；正如聖經所說，若翰將要宣告：「看，天主的羔羊！」

我們的主說：好樹不結壞果子，壞樹也不結好果子。好樹和壞樹都會結果子，但只有義人的果實，才能為他人發出光明，就如今天的聖依撒伯爾一樣。

義人與作惡的人都必須忍受磨難。然而，天主考驗義人，是為使他們更加聖善，從而獲得天上的賞報；作惡的人則受到提醒，不要再犯罪。若他們不悔改，就會走向永罰之地。

願聖母幫助我們，時常按照正直的良心行事，並常常向上主祈求智慧。

en.title: Odd-Thursday of the Fourth Week of Advent: St. Elizabeth’s Virtue and the Name of John
en.content:
St. Elizabeth is a woman of great virtue. For the most important thing for a woman is to be fruitful, not barren. But God had a special plan for Lisa. Her infertility was not because God was punishing her, but because God was helping her to sharpen her virtue.

Now on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; they were going to call him Zechariah.Why was the name given after the circumcise?

because no man except he first cast aside his fleshly lusts, which circumcision signifies, is worthy to have his name written in the book of life.

The reason why God did not give him the name Zacharias becouse Zacharias means is “remembering God,” and John means is “pointing to.” Now “memory” relates to something absent, “pointing to,” to something present. But John was not about to set forth the memory of God as absent, As the Bible says, John would say: Behold the Lamb of God.

Our lord said:a good tree does not bear bad fruit; a bad tree does not bear good fruit. Both good and bad trees bear fruit. But it is only the fruit of the righteous that shines for others, just as it does for the St. Elizabeth today.

Both the righteous and the evildoers must endure, but God tests the righteous in order to make them more holy and thus earn the rewards of heaven; but the evildoers are reminded not to sin again, and if they do not repent, they will go to the place of eternal punishment.

May Our Lady help us always to act in right conscience and always to ask the Lord for wisdom.

homilies.title: 單-將臨期第四週星期六早上道理：天主的慷慨與達味的忠信
homilies.content:
誰能明白天主的心意？我們能理解一位慷慨的天主嗎？有時候，天主知道我們的善意，我們也願意向祂奉獻外在美好的事物，祂卻不接受。相反地，祂願意賜給我們更多、更豐盛的恩惠。

為什麼呢？因為天主的慷慨，總是遠遠超過人的慷慨。我們付出自己的辛勞，例如祈禱、努力工作、奉獻工資。我們看似有所損失，卻獲得更多健康、恩惠、家庭的平安、內心的平安等等。

這一切正如耶穌所說：你們給，也就給你們，並且用十足的升斗，連按帶搖，以致外溢，倒在你們的懷裏；因為你們用什麼升斗量，也用什麼升斗量給你們。

在今天的讀經中，達味住進自己的宮殿，上主使他安享太平，不再受到四周仇敵的侵擾。納堂對君王說：「你心中打算的，你全可照辦，因為上主與你同在。」

但結果卻出乎達味的意料。天主要達味奉獻的，並不是聖殿，而是達味對祂的忠信。正因為他對天主忠信，他才獲得了天下，而天主也喜悅他的作為。

對一位父親而言，他需要子女給他什麼呢？

無非就是愛。看見自己的孩子成長，並努力為他做許多事，我們美善的上主就滿足了。

因此，我們知道，因著達味的請求，天主使最偉大的君王從他的後裔中誕生，就是基督，永恆的和平之王。祂的仁慈與偉大，使我們能永遠信賴祂；沒有別的神比基督更了解人。

願聖母引領我們走向慈悲的天父，使我們全心接受祂唯一聖子的教導。

en.title: Odd-Saturday Morning of the Fourth Week of Advent: God’s Generosity and David’s Faithfulness
en.content:
Who can understand the mind of God? Or can we understand a generous God?Or sometimes God knows our good intentions, and we are willing to offer Him outwardly good things, but He does not accept them. Instead, he wants to give us more and more abundant favors

Why? Because of God's generosity, which is always far greater than that of man. We give of our hard work. For example: prayer, hard work, wages. We seem to lose, but we do gain more health, favour, family peace, inner peace, etc.

And all this as Jesus said:Give, and there will be gifts for you: a full measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be poured into your lap; because the amount you measure out is the amount you will be given back.’

In today's reading, :Once David had settled into his house and the Lord had given him rest from all the enemies surrounding him, Nathan said to the king, ‘Go and do all that is in your mind, for the Lord is with you.’

But the result was unexpected for David. For it was not the temple that God wanted David to give him. Rather, it was the faithfulness of David to him. It is because of his faithfulness to God that he got the world. And God was pleased with his work.

For a father, what does he need from his children?

It is nothing but love. He sees his child grow and try to do a lot for him, and our good Lord is satisfied.

As a result, we know that because of the request of David, God has given birth to the greatest of kings from his offspring. That is Christ, the eternal King of Peace. His mercy, his greatness, is such that we can trust him forever, and there is no other God more understanding of people than Christ.

May Our Lady lead us to the Merciful Father and accept with all our hearts the teachings of His only Son.

homilies.title: 單-四旬期第1週星期五道理：更圓滿的義德與和好
homilies.content:
今天的福音說：

耶穌對門徒說：「除非你們的義德超過經師和法利賽人的義德，你們決進不了天國。」

這裡所說的德行，就是義德。

在這裡，我們要留意新約如何超越舊約。耶穌要求門徒明白，新的比舊的更為美好，而新的導師將舊約的一切真理，完整地表達出來。

然而，我們的主並沒有稱經師和法利賽人為不義的人，而是談到「他們的德行，也就是義德」。

耶穌要告訴我們，經師和法利賽人，

他們的義德也有價值，因為他們同樣遵守法律；但新約的義德比這更為深遠。

也就是說，舊約的義德也是真實的，但新約的義德更加圓滿。兩者同屬一類，都是天主的正義，只是啟示的深度不同。

最後，在四旬期中，讓我們特別反省：是否曾得罪某位弟兄，卻還沒有請求他的寬恕，而我們仍繼續向天主奉獻禮物？也許因為我們尚未寬恕弟兄，我們的奉獻便不蒙上主接納，結果所做的成了徒然。

只要信友之間仍有不和，也許正因如此，我們的奉獻不受重視，祈禱也不常蒙天主俯允。

願聖母幫助我們，寬恕所有曾傷害我們的弟兄姊妹。

en.title: Odd-Friday of the First Week of Lent: Fuller Righteousness and Reconciliation
en.content:
In the Gospel today:

Jesus said to his disciples: ‘If your virtue goes no deeper than that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never get into the kingdom of heaven.

The virtue here means righteousness.

Here we shall observe about the preference of the New Testament over the Old. Jesus asks his disciples to understand that the new is better than the old, and that the new teacher speaks the whole truth of the Old Testament in its fullness.

But our lord he does not call the Scribes and Pharisees unrighteous, but speaks of “their virtue(righteousness).”

Jesus wants to tell us that the scribes and Pharisees,

Their virtue also had value, because they also obeyed the law; but the New Testament is even more than that.

That is to say, the righteousness of the Old Testament is also true, but the righteousness of the New Testament is more complete. The two are of the same kind, that is, the Divine Righteousness, but the depth of revelation is not the same.

Finally, during Lent, let us reflect especially on whether we have sinned against a certain brother and we have not asked for forgiveness. Yet we continue to offer gifts to God. It may be that our gift is not accepted by the Lord because we have not forgiven our brother, and then we have done it in vain.

For as long as there is disagreement among the faithful, perhaps because of this our gifts are not valued and our prayers are not often answered by God.

May Our Lady help us to forgive all our brothers and sisters who have hurt us.

homilies.title: 葡萄園的比喻：基督是屋角的基石
homilies.content:
在今天的福音中:耶穌又假設了一個比喻:

從前有一個家主，培植了一個葡萄園，周圍圍上籬笆，園內挖了一個榨酒池，築了一個守望臺，把它租給園戶，就離開了本國。

這個比喻的最後目的是說明法利賽人和經師的罪行是令人髮指的，並且不值得被寬恕；又或者我們要說他們自願的不願被寬恕。

在比喻中家主就是天主，它有一個葡萄園---就是代表以色列家族，周圍圍上籬笆，意思就是以色列家族是受到天主特別照顧和保護的民族。正如我們所知道的出穀紀，天主藉著梅瑟幫助他們逃離法老王的毒手，而在之後天主都是一只不斷的幫助以色列人打勝仗。

之後園內挖了一個榨酒池，榨酒池就是天主的話或著也可以說是聖神的恩寵。這一個榨酒池本身是好的，但若人不遵守天主的話，那我們所喝的酒就使人難受；如果願意開始遵守的話，這酒就能成就人，並使人在遵守天主的話上面越來越輕鬆。

而後，又築了一個守望臺，意思就是指法律，它從地上延伸至天上，從而可以窺見基督的來臨，藉此可以傳授給百姓瞭解法律的奧秘。這裏也是說明司祭總是要爬到最高處，並且時時注視基督的傳授與魔鬼的進攻。從而幫助民眾及時做好準備。

之後園主就離開了本國，不是說天主不在注視世上的事情，因為天主總是充滿萬物治理萬物，並維持萬物的存在。這裡所要表達的是天主給人的自由意志，其中包括行善與作惡。也是說明還沒有到真正審判的時間。

最後耶穌說:

匠人棄而不用的石頭，反而成了屋角的基石。

這句話正是要我們要相信，主耶穌就是要來的那一位。這個耶穌祂

不只是信仰上我們所認識的耶穌，也是真正出現在歷史上的耶穌，祂的偉大不只在於祂是人的這方面，更是因為祂是天主。伯多祿總是祂提醒我們:唯有耶穌有永生的話，我們還能相信誰呢?

願聖母幫助我們在信德的道路上，瞭解不管在黑暗還是光明，耶穌都一只與我們同行。

homilies.title: 讓耶穌成為家中的中心
homilies.content:
家是我們身心的港灣，是人生的依靠，也是我們最大的滿足與喜樂。

沒有什麼地方像家一樣，讓人感到受歡迎、安靜、舒適而自在。家不該是孤單或荒廢的地方，而是讓人感受到愛的所在。出門時，其他東西都可以不帶，卻要記得帶上鑰匙，因為家是我們終究要回去的地方。

然而，在這世上，單靠人的力量不足以支撐一個家庭。人的心總是軟弱，正如聖灰星期三提醒我們，我們原是灰土。

因此，天主聖父派遣聖子，好讓我們在生活中把耶穌放在首位，讓祂成為家中最重要的一位。

在今天的福音中，猶太人的帳棚節近了，耶穌也上去了，卻是暗中去的，沒有引人注意。

「祂也上去了，卻是暗中去的。」這句話提醒我們，基督正是這節日暗中所預示的那一位。祂隱身於節慶的人群中，就像舊約時，天主在帳棚中默默扶助以色列人。

這也預示基督的肢體將在異鄉寄居。耶穌提醒我們，我們仍在前往福地的路上，而祂已先到那裡，為我們預備好一切。這個世界並非我們的福地。

如果我們還穿著舊衣，就該先脫下，因為到了那個新的地方，我們要穿上新衣。這意味著要除去我們的鐵石心腸，換上一顆柔軟的心。我們要學習克己，放下凡事要人服事的心態，多為眾人的得救作犧牲，並以十字架為我們最好的老師和朋友。

願聖母引導我們，在四旬期中找到守齋的真正意義。

en.title: Putting Jesus First in Our Home
en.content:
Home is our physical and mental harbour, our support point in life, and our greatest fulfillment and joy in life.

There is no place like the welcome, the quiet, the comfort and the freedom of home. Home refuses to be lonely or rusty, it is always a place where people feel loved. We can leave everything behind when we go out, but we must take your keys with us. Because home is where we have to come back to.

But in this world, man is not sufficient to sustain a family, for the human heart is always weak, as Ash Wednesday tells us: we are all made of dust.

So, God the Father sent the Son so that we would put Jesus first in our lives. It is for Jesus to be the most important member of our family.

In today's Gospel:As the Jewish feast of Tabernacles drew near, Jesus went up as well, but quite privately, without drawing attention to himself.

"he went up as well, but quite privately". It is telling us:For he himself was the thing foreshadowed in secret, for Christ was hidden at that feast just as the Old Testament God was secretly helping Israel in his tent. 

This is also a sign that the members of Christ would take up residence in a foreign land.Jesus wants to tell us that until now we have been going to the promised land , and he has been there prepared everything for us first(in this earth isn’t our promised land).

But, If we are still wearing our old clothes, we should take them off first, because the new place is only for those who wear new clothes. This means that the new place requires breaking down our hearts of stone and replacing them with soft hearts; and practising self-denial rather than being served; making more sacrifices for the salvation of many souls; and seeing the cross as our best teacher and friend.

May Our Lady guide us in finding the true meaning of fasting during Lent

homilies.title: 耶穌是真人，也是真天主
homilies.content:
在今天的福音中，猶太人對耶穌說：「你是人，卻把自己當作天主。」其實，這樣的質疑在我們這個時代仍然存在。

《主耶穌》（Dominus Iesus）宣言重申，耶穌基督的啟示具有決定性和完整性。我們應堅信，在降生成人的天主子耶穌基督身上，天主完整地啟示了祂的真理。耶穌是「道路、真理、生命」（若 14:6）。「除了父，沒有人認識子；除了子和子所願意啟示的人外，也沒有人認識父」（瑪 11:27）。因為在基督內，天主性的一切圓滿都親身居住在祂內，而你們也在祂內得到了圓滿（哥 2:9–10）。

為什麼相信耶穌是真天主如此重要？因為這是事實。耶穌是一位仁慈的人，行了許多愛德善工，也照顧病人，但祂的身分遠不止於此。祂也是天主，祂的天主性與人性不可分離。如果祂只是人，祂所能做的便有限，無法替我們償還欠天主的無限債務。如果祂只是天主，沒有真正成為人，祂就不能為我們受苦，我們也就無法明白天主多麼愛我們，更無法真心愛祂。

因此，教會宣認耶穌是真人，也是真天主。天主親自生活在這世上，取了奴僕的形體，出於愛為我們受苦。天主選擇了最大的愛，把祂的獨生子完全交給我們。聖父所愛的獨生子是無罪的，卻承受了最深的苦難。這一切都引導我們注目於天主的愛子。從聖父對聖子的愛，我們明白聖父是多麼愛我們。

願聖母幫助我們在四旬期中，更深地領悟聖子對我們的愛。

en.title: Jesus Is True Man and True God
en.content:
In Today’s Gospel:Jews said to Jesus that  you are only a man and you claim to be God. Actually, this situation is still occurring in our century.

So,In the book of Declaration Dominus Jesus.

Reaffirm the decisive and complete character of the revelation of Jesus Christ. Originally, it should be firmly believed that in the miracle of Jesus Christ, the Son of God, born of man, who is "the way, the truth and the life" (Jn 14:6), and the full revelation of the truth of the Divine Nature was given: "no one knows the Son except the Father, just as no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him." (Mat 11:27); and "for it is in Christ In his body lives the fullness of divinity, and in him you too find your own fulfilment," (Col 2:9).kuh·lo·shnz

Why it is important to believe that Jesus is the real God is because it is a reality. This Jesus is more than just a charitable tʃærətəbl person, and more than a person who does a lot of works of charity and cares for the sick. He is also God, and neither of these two natures can be separated. For if He is only human: He can do only a limited amount and cannot help us to redeem the infinite ˈɪnfɪnət debt we owe to God. If He is only God, and not a real person.  Then He cannot suffer for us, and therefore we cannot understand how much God loves us, nor can we have true love for Him.

So the Church declares that Jesus is a true man and true God. This means that God lived in this world and took on the body of a slave to suffer for us in order to love us. God chose the greatest love of all, that He gave His only Son to us completely. The Father's beloved Son was innocent, but suffered the most. Everything is intended to help us focus on God's beloved Son. Through His love for the Son, we learn how much the Father loves us.

May the Blessed Mother help us to better understand the love of the Holy Son for us during Lent.
